EVE's Producer career track in one job: the ore, the bench, the delivery. A craft whose ingredients include a
mid-rarity ore, then a deliver, at a site on a planet that carries it (MB56a's place.resource).

REWORKED 2026-11-10 (Eliza's 11-09 bring letter; OT-32 retired on his 10:07 ruling, 'limit the mission to a single planet where we know the resources are there'): the tungsten ingredient is ResInorgUncommonTungsten (a craft takes the Resource record, the lint says so); pinned to Bolivar I.

CARD 2026-11-10 (his 11-04 ruling, a posting by whoever set the job: no payer label, no payment line; his 11-10 'we still have all those X Contract things'). Was: "Private Contract. Make a set of tungsten drill bits and deliver them to the <Place> on <Planet>. Payment on contract completion."
